q: How does a buyer of Qatari LNG count its upstream emissions in Scope 3?
title: Qatari LNG: upstream in Scope 3
short: Burning the LNG is Scope 1. Everything before your gate, from gas extraction and processing to liquefaction, shipping and regasification, goes in Scope 3 Category 3 as fuel and energy related activities. Use a supplier or cargo specific figure if you have one, otherwise a published well to tank factor, and say which.
audience: Utilities, fertiliser makers, glass and ceramics plants and city gas distributors burning imported LNG

ul: Scope 1: combustion at your site, from the gas quantity on invoices.
Scope 3 Category 3: upstream extraction, processing, liquefaction, shipping and regasification.

p: A supplier figure per cargo or per contract is best. A published well to tank factor is acceptable when labelled as secondary data. Do not mix LNG and pipeline gas factors.
Invoices with quantities in kg, tonnes or MMBtu, and the factor source and year.

senseible: Senseible reads purchase invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each supplier figure in your Scope 3 sits next to the quantity and the document it applies to.
